description: Control run: single-slice (gray) input with the same early stopping as the 2.5D run (lungnodule 0.8.0 notebook, QUICK_RUN = False)
purpose: Check whether early stopping, rather than the 2.5D input, explains the 2.5D run's higher CPM.

result.identical_to: results/luna16-subset9/candidates.csv (the first run, 100 epochs without early stopping)
result.conclusion: Training is deterministic and the first run's best checkpoint was also epoch 32, so early stopping evaluated the same model: byte-identical candidates and the same CPM. The 2.5D run's gain over single slices is therefore due to the input, for this seed.

files.training_curves.png: Ultralytics training and validation curves (56 epochs, early stopping)
files.eigencam.csv, eigencam.json, eigencam.pn: Eigen-CAM box energy of the top 200 candidates of this run
